The '''Republic base camp''' was the primary staging point used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]] fought between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The camp consisted of an underground base and a number of tents and was used by [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]] as his base of operations.<ref name="TOR" />
